name: テンプレート初期タスクと担当役割の編集表
prompt:
Recreate the supplied Asana project-template task editor as a faithful Japanese localization. Match the exact 841 by 670 pixel crop and its portrait-leaning 1.255:1 aspect ratio. Include only the visible central editor; do not add the left navigation or right customization panel.

At the top, reproduce the white project header. At x about 34 and y about 27, place a 62-pixel soft-gray rounded square with the dark project-board glyph. To its right show the bold project title 「プロジェクトキックオフ」. Below that title, retain the small outlined selector pill with a list icon and 「デフォルトビュー：リスト」. A thin gray divider spans the canvas around y=114.

Below the divider, place the blue primary split button 「＋ タスクを追加」 at the left with a separate small dropdown segment on its right, matching the reference size and position. Add another thin divider near y=187. Then show a simple two-column task table with a white header row and thin dividers. The left column is wide and labeled 「名前」; the right column is labeled 「担当者」 and begins around x=656.

Reproduce exactly three task rows. The first row is selected with a pale blue background and has a small hourglass/status icon, the task name 「プロジェクト概要を作成」, and a small generic assignee/role icon with the label 「プロジェクトマネージャー」. The second row has a circular check icon, the task name 「計画書をチームに共有」, and a small circular portrait avatar with the name “Alex Smith”. The third row has a circular check icon, the task name 「キックオフミーティングを予定」, and the generic role icon with 「プロジェクトマネージャー」. Preserve the source row heights, text alignment, divider lines, status icons and blue selected-row color. Follow with the muted placeholder row 「タスクを追加...」.

In the lower half, retain three task sections in this order: 「未着手」 with a right-pointing collapsed disclosure triangle; 「進行中」 with a down-pointing disclosure triangle; and 「完了」 with a down-pointing disclosure triangle. Keep the same generous vertical gaps and left indentation as the source. At the bottom edge, include the plus icon and 「セクションを追加」 row, slightly clipped by the crop as in the reference.

Use a clean Asana-like task-list style: compact modern sans-serif type, dark charcoal text, subtle gray dividers, small monochrome status icons, white background, and restrained blue for the selected row and Add task button. Keep all visible controls and assignments inside the 841 by 670 crop. Do not invent extra tasks, assignees, columns, section rows, or right-side content.
reviewNotes: Task rows and section states match the reference closely. Needs correction: the selector and Add Task control are oversized, the assignee column begins too far left, and Project Manager role labels clip at the right edge. Version 2 will compact controls, align the assignee divider, and use the shorter Japanese role label プロジェクト管理者.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
